explanation: This route is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because page_name is percent-formatted directly into two db.query() calls. An attacker requesting a crafted path could manipulate the SQL statements to access or modify arbitrary database data. The repair parameterizes only the first query with $1 and leaves the second query ('select id from page where page_name = '%s'' % page_name) vulnerable, while external db.query binding is not shown.
